title: Preliminary Study with the Use of a Titanium Mesh as Space Maker and Implant Primary Stabilization for One -Stage Sinus Lift in Cases with Less Than 1.5 mm Residual Bone
authors: Filipov I, Bolognesi F, Chirila L, Cristache CM, Corinaldesi G, Park KB. J Clin Med. 2021 Oct 22;10(21):4853. doi: 10.3390/jcm10214853.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The results of the present preliminary study demonstrated that the proposed "butterfly" technique was effective when performing one-stage sinus lifting and simultaneous implant placement in cases with less than 1.5 mm of residual alveolar bone. The survival rate was 100% at 1-year post occlusal loading” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
